projects.title: Picnic Games
projects.shortDescription: Interactive picnic and party games discovery platform.
projects.fullDescription: A responsive web application for discovering indoor and outdoor picnic and party games for kids, males, females, families, and groups. The project includes category filtering, game instructions, interactive browsing, search functionality, responsive layouts, and modern user interface elements.

projects.title: FureverCare
projects.shortDescription: Modern pet adoption and pet care platform.
projects.fullDescription: A modern pet-focused web application built with React and Tailwind CSS. The platform provides sections for pet adoption, pet care information, services, blog content, feedback, and contact functionality. The project focuses on reusable React components, responsive layouts, modern UI design, and a smooth user experience.

projects.title: Travel Smart
projects.shortDescription: Interactive travel and tourism discovery platform.
projects.fullDescription: A modern travel platform developed with React and Tailwind CSS. It helps users explore destinations, browse trips, filter travel options, compare experiences, and interact with visually engaging destination content. The project focuses on component-based development, responsive design, animations, and modern frontend architecture.

projects.title: Head Tail Game
projects.shortDescription: Interactive browser-based Head or Tail game.
projects.fullDescription: A lightweight browser game developed using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Players choose Head or Tail and compete against computer-generated results. The application includes score tracking, responsive layouts, dynamic interactions, and game-state logic.

projects.title: Nizaliah
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack e-commerce platform developed with Laravel.
projects.fullDescription: A full-stack e-commerce project for Nizaliah developed using Laravel. The project focuses on product management, shopping functionality, database-driven content, backend business logic, responsive frontend design, and an architecture suitable for expanding into a real online store.

projects.title: Madrasa Dar-ul-Falah
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack educational institution website built with Laravel.
projects.fullDescription: A Laravel-based website created for Madrasa Dar-ul-Falah. The system presents information about courses, admissions, events, programs, achievements, and institutional activities while using Laravel for application structure and backend functionality.

projects.title: Nizaliah Interactive Experience
projects.shortDescription: Cinematic Nizaliah experience built around scroll-based animation.
projects.fullDescription: A visually driven Nizaliah web experience focused on cinematic presentation, scroll-triggered animation, premium product storytelling, and immersive transitions. The project demonstrates creative frontend development and the use of motion to build a more engaging product experience.

projects.title: Interactive E-Bike Experience
projects.shortDescription: Interactive 3D e-bike experience with scroll-based assembly and disassembly.
projects.fullDescription: An experimental interactive e-bike website combining scroll-driven animation with a 3D product model. As the user scrolls, the e-bike transitions between assembled and exploded states to visually explain individual components and product construction. The project focuses on immersive interaction, motion design, 3D presentation, and product storytelling.

projects.title: James Thew Recipe Platform
projects.shortDescription: Recipe and culinary platform developed with .NET.
projects.fullDescription: A .NET-based web application focused on recipe discovery and culinary content. The project demonstrates structured application development within the Microsoft .NET ecosystem and includes a dedicated Visual Studio solution and application project.
